1315-5531-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
1315-5531-6621-8345.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat.

512-7014-7704.easyPrerequisites: Doc Samson and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-7014-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Doc Samson, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-7014-7704.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Doc Samson's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

339-677-1251-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-7192.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4499-4747-5434.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

3617-5144-6991.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Donnie & April and exiling Ephemerate.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

500-2081-2719-3191.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-2081-2719-3191.notes: The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

206-2457-2557-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

176-6705-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-6705-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Quina.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

4050-6529-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

618-4783-6797.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser with haste.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
Choose to return Kiki-Jiki to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train trigger from step 3.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger from step 2, putting Kiki-Jiki from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

4222-4644-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat.

1486-1680-1753-7014.description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat
1486-1680-1753-7014.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

315-4396-4465--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2350-3532-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

339-677-1753-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2038-4013-4772.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Kozilek's Predator.
When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2615-5295-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-5295-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

813-957-2072.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns.
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each other turn.
813-957-2072.notes: If desired, you can do steps 2 and 3 during the first extra turn instead to spread out the mana costs.

116-4284-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Clone on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Clone do not have summoning sickness.
116-4284-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Clone.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Clone.
Activate Clone by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Clone ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

2099-5361-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2099-5361-5365.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Auton Soldier's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.
2099-5361-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

2060-2577-3602-3967.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2060-2577-3602-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

876-1409-2691.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Ilysian Caryatid.
876-1409-2691.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Ilysian Caryatid.
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ilysian Caryatid enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbound ability triggers, repairing it and Ilysian Caryatid.
Repeat.

618-4367.notablePrerequisites:
Kiki-Jiki is modified.
You control another modified creature that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
618-4367.description:
Declare another modified creature you control as an attacker.
Akki Battle Squad triggers, untapping all modified creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Akki Battle Squad with haste.
Repeat each combat phase.

1168-1479-3756.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1168-1479-3756.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Toggo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Toggo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

391-1584-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-1584-3525.description:
Activate Teferi's Isle by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Teferi's Isle.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.

617-1283-2179.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrey's second ability to draw any number of cards.
